Sandbox_BWMachine_CycleDuration_tooltip:
How long a washing machine cycle lasts, in game minutes.
Clothes are cleaned gradually and finish exactly at the end of the cycle.
A running cycle keeps the duration it started with.
Sandbox_BWMachine_DryingCycleDuration_to:
How long a clothes dryer cycle lasts, in game minutes.
Clothing wetness decreases gradually and reaches zero at the end of the cycle.
A running cycle keeps the duration it started with.
Sandbox_BWMachine_WaterPerCycle_tooltip:
Total water taken from the machine's own water supply during one full cycle, in the same units shown by the machine's fluid amount.
It is spent evenly over the cycle. 0 makes washing free.
If the supply runs dry the cycle stops.
This is the amount for a full load (100%); lighter loads use the percentages below.
Sandbox_BWMachine_LowLoadWater_tooltip: Percentage of 'Water per Cycle' used by a light load.
Sandbox_BWMachine_MediumLoadWater_toolti: Percentage of 'Water per Cycle' used by a medium load.
